title: RA - AI Agent
tagline: RA - AI Agent allows users to initialize the Research mode while publishing it as an NFT, granting them full ownership.
description: It let's user open the extension from the website where they want to do the research and helps them to write the research from it without having to take notes every single second using Pinecone and openai's RAG implementation, after that users can share their research with other people as a NFT with it's full ownership.
how_its_made: I used Foundry to deploy the smart contract I wrote in Solidity and verified it using BlockScout. To retrieve data from the current browser, I built an extension using Vite. For storing the data and performing vector searches, I’m using Pinecone DB with OpenAI for RAG implementation.
